_source: Name Registry page (/name-registry/): the Airtable shared view, embedded exactly as before.
title: Name Registry
text: Search every registered name and see which flag it is honored on. On a computer you can filter by Branch, Cause of Death and Flag Number. The easiest way to find a name is to click the magnifying glass and type the name in.
On a phone, filtering and search are not available inside the embedded registry: open it full screen instead.
